en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To provide basic knowledge in the field of animal nutrition, technological procedures for modifying feed to improve its quality, the use of feed in animal nutrition, feed additives and the basics of feeding technology with the aim of producing high-quality and safe food. Subject content: Nutrition and feeding of commercial rabbits (1/0). Nutrition and feeding of individual categories of horses (subsidy 1/1). Nutrition and feeding of pigs (subsidy 3/3). Poultry nutrition and feeding (subsidy 3/3). Nutrition and feeding of ruminants (4/3).

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Effects of some nutrient in animal body, nutritional requirements and sources of nutrient. Factors that influence digestibility of food. Evaluation of protein quality and energy content of food. Pollutants in food chain. Quality evaluation and production technology of feed mixtures. Knowledge of feedstuffs production with regard to market. Methods of feedstuffs processing, process preservation and storage of roughage. Feed additives in animal nutrition, their importance, principles of their functions, using, application, residues. Ruminants nutrition. Feeding technology of cows, fattening of cattle. Nutrition and technologies of pigs and poultry feeding. Effect of nutrition on the quality of foodstuffs of animal origin, the effect of nutrition on the milk and egg quality. Influence of nutrition on the carcass composition and on meat and fat quality. (allowance 12/18) a.technology of feedb.feed conservationc.legislations2.feed and technological aditives (allowance 6/0)3.energy evaluation in feeds (allowance 6/6)

en.content: Credit will be awarded on the basis of min. 80% participation in exercises and min. 70% success rate in credit test. Exam: The exam consists of a written and an oral part.
